mission: Run the full sdp-trace verification suite after each slice and report pass/fail/cannot_verify for every gate.
customInstructions: Run in this order: go build ./..., go test -count=1 ./... -coverprofile, go tool cover -func, go run ./tools/qualitycheck (cyclo, cognitive, MI baselines), go run ./tools/crapcheck, go vet ./..., go run ./tools/doccheck, git diff --check.
Compare command-surface JSON and --help against baseline snapshots.
Report each verifier state as pass, fail, cannot_verify, or not_assessed.
If any gate fails, stop immediately and report which command produced the failure.
